'''Orn Free Taa's shuttle'''<ref name="Shuttle DB">{{Databank|orn-free-taa-s-shuttle|Orn Free Taa's Shuttle}}</ref> was the personal [[shuttle]] of [[Senator]] [[Orn Free Taa]] of [[Ryloth]]. Kept in a private [[hangar]] in the [[Capitol]] building in [[Lessu City|Lessu]],<ref name="Rescue on Ryloth" /> Taa believed the shuttle's existence was a secret, so he could make a hasty retreat to [[Coruscant]] if need be.<ref name="Shuttle DB" /> However, [[Eleni Syndulla]] knew of the shuttle's existence, and when she and her [[Marriage|husband]] [[Cham Syndulla|Cham]] and other members of the [[Free Ryloth Movement]] were [[Rescue on Ryloth|rescued]] by members of [[Clone Force 99]] early in the [[Imperial Era]], they used the shuttle as an escape vehicle. Cham kept the [[starship]] afterwards, as he and his followers departed [[Ord Mantell]] after regrouping there with their rescuers.<ref name="Rescue on Ryloth" />
